name: Kuga Hinata
source: A member of [url=/c28462]Alice's[/url] student council and the other member of the idol duo "Shiny". She is [url=/c28465]Lili's[/url] best and only friend. Unlike Lili, her personality does not change when she works. Also loves surfing around the internet.
